info.title: Hotel Hall Booking Management System API
info.description: Documented per docs/03-standards/api-standards.md §16. One `paths`/`components.schemas` section grows per module as each is implemented — this file currently covers Authentication & Account Management (Module 1), Hotel Management (Module 3), and Hall Management (Module 4, partial — only the endpoints actually implemented so far).

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Identity, login, account lifecycle (Module 1). Endpoints per docs/05-technical-design/modules/01-authentication-and-account-management/technical-design.md §10.

tags.name: Hotels
tags.description: The Hotel business entity and its onboarding lifecycle (Module 3). Endpoints per docs/05-technical-design/modules/03-hotel-management/technical-design.md §11. No approve/reject/suspend/deactivate endpoint exists here — that action belongs to Administration & Platform Management's own future API surface (BR-HOTEL-14).

tags.name: Halls
tags.description: The Hall entity — the Platform's bookable inventory (Module 4). Endpoints per docs/05-technical-design/modules/04-hall-management/technical-design.md §11. Includes the public, platform-wide browse endpoint and the own-Hotel-scoped create/retrieve/update/list-for-Hotel endpoints (WBS-05), authorized through Hotel Management's Hotel Ownership Query Interface (Technical Design v1.5).

tags.name: Administration
tags.description: Platform Administrator hotel application review endpoints required to complete the implemented Hotel onboarding workflow.

tags.name: Bookings
tags.description: Customer booking requests and own-Hotel Manager lifecycle management (Module 5).

PublicUser.description: A User Account, never including passwordHash (data-architecture.md §13, Restricted).

PublicHotel.description: The Hotel entity (Technical Design §4). profileData shape is deliberately unspecified — Business Specification Pending Business Decision #7.

PublicHotelApplication.description: One review cycle (Technical Design §4) — a resubmission creates a new record, never overwrites a decided one.

CustomerProfile.description: Customer business profile. No profile fields are approved yet, so profileData currently accepts only an empty object. avatarUrl is a stable, non-expiring public URL derived from the stored avatar at read time (mirrors Hotel Media's own PublicHotelMedia.url convention) — null until the Customer uploads one.

isComplete.description: Null while profile-completion rules remain unresolved.

MyHotelSnapshot.description: Server-backed Hotel Manager context for Manager Mobile: the latest Hotel owned by the caller, its latest application when one exists, and its real review aggregate.

ReviewSummary.description: A Hotel's real average rating and review count — the same aggregate the public Hotel Detail endpoint already exposes to Customers. `average` is `null` (not `0`) when the Hotel has zero reviews.

PublicHotelMedia.description: A single uploaded Hotel Logo or Photo (BDR-015, ADR-0006, Technical Design §4, §8a). `url` is a stable, non-expiring public URL derived from the stored path at read time — never a temporary signed URL.

HotelMediaSummary.description: Hotel media embedded in a Hotel response.

PublicHallMedia.description: A single uploaded Hall Photo (BDR-016, ADR-0007, Shared Media Technical Design v0.2). `url` is a stable, non-expiring public URL derived from the stored path at read time — never a temporary signed URL.

PublicHall.description: The Hall entity (Technical Design §4). profileData's required/optional/custom structure is defined by BDR-016 (name, capacity required; description, location optional; any other key is a custom field) — the object itself remains unstructured JSON, no per-field schema properties. `isActive` is the owning Hotel Manager's own Active/Inactive toggle — a non-owner never sees an inactive Hall at all (a request for one behaves exactly as if it didn't exist), so this field is only ever meaningful to the owning Manager's own view.

post.summary: Create a Hall belonging to a Hotel
post.description: HL1, HL2, BR-HALL-02 — Technical Design §11. Own-Hotel only. No precondition on the owning Hotel's own status — a Hall may be created whether the Hotel is REGISTERED, APPROVED_ACTIVE, or anything between. Per BDR-016 (Approved), profileData.name and profileData.capacity are required.

profileData.description: BDR-016: name and capacity required; description, location, and any custom key are optional.

400.description: Malformed request shape, missing/empty Hall Name, or missing/invalid Capacity (BDR-016).

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired access token.

404.description: hotelId doesn't exist, or isn't owned by the caller (api-standards.md §13, tenant isolation — never 403).

get.description: Technical Design §11. Public, with conditional behavior: the owning Hotel Manager sees every Hall regardless of visibility, optionally narrowed by `status`; anyone else always sees Active Halls only, while the Hotel is eligible (BR-HOTEL-04/05), or an empty page otherwise. `search` matches `profileData.name` (case-insensitive substring), the same convention Hotel Management's own Hotel-name search already uses. Offset pagination (coding-standards.md §6 — a bounded, per-Hotel list), distinct from the platform-wide GET /halls' cursor pagination.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Owning Hotel Manager only — narrows their own "All" view. Ignored (Active is already forced) for anyone else.

200.description: A page of Halls — every Hall if the caller is the owning Hotel Manager, otherwise only Visible ones (possibly an empty page).

404.description: hotelId doesn't exist.

get.description: HL2, HL5, HL6 — Technical Design §11, §14.3. Public, with conditional behavior: if a valid token for the owning Hotel Manager is presented, the Hall is returned regardless of visibility; otherwise (no token, or a token for a different Hotel) it is returned only if Visible.

404.description: Hall doesn't exist, belongs to a different Hotel, or is Hidden and the caller isn't its owning Hotel Manager — never distinguished (api-standards.md §9, "never leak existence", generalized to visibility per Technical Design §6/§12).

patch.description: HL3, BR-HALL-07 — Technical Design §11. Own-Hotel only. Every well-formed, authorized change applies immediately — no review step exists for Halls. If name or capacity is included, per BDR-016 it is content-validated (non-empty name, valid positive-integer capacity); every other key (description, location, custom fields) is merged unvalidated beyond shape.

schema.description: One or more profile fields to change; at least one field required.

name.description: Optional on update; if present, must be non-empty (BDR-016).

capacity.description: Optional on update; if present, must be a valid positive integer (BDR-016).

isActive.description: The owning Manager's Active/Inactive toggle. false hides this Hall from Customer browsing/booking; the owning Manager still sees and can re-activate it.

400.description: Malformed fields, an empty update body, or an included name/capacity that fails content validation (BDR-016).

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired access token.

404.description: Hall not found, or belongs to a Hotel the caller doesn't own (never 403).
